ISTANBUL — ARKOJTECT is a curatorial galley dedicated to contemporary collectible design and art by Turkish artisans.
The gallery brings together collectible design and art shaped by Istanbul’s artists, designers and local artisans.
The gallery aims to bring the creative practices of local workshops and the knowledge behind their making into dialogue with the international collectible design scene.

Furniture, lighting, mirrors and functional objects sit alongside sculpture and wall art, selected for their material character, craftsmanship and presence within a space. One-of-a-kind works, limited editions and bespoke pieces reveal different ways of translating an idea into a physical object.

The gallery brings established names and emerging voices together across both design and art. A prime example is Zeynep Fadıllıoğlu, who is internationally recognized as the first woman to design the interior of a mosque, brings her sensitivity to colour, texture and craftsmanship to pieces such as the Gloss side table. Meanwhile, Tayfun Mumcu’s furniture and objects bring together aesthetic references from different periods through material and craftsmanship.

ARKOBJECT was founded by Sami Savatli, an Istanbul-based designer whose practice spans architecture, interiors, furniture and collectible design. He founded SAVATLI Architects in 2010. His work explores the relationship between material, form and spatial experience.

During his nearly 35-year career, Rich has toured more than 250 woodworking operations throughout North America, Europe and Asia and has written extensively on woodworking technology, design and supply trends. He has also directed and promoted dozens of woodworking trade shows, conferences and seminars including the Cabinets & Closets Conference & Expo and the Woodworking Machinery & Supply Conference & Expo, Canada’s largest woodworking show.
